detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The Cultivation Content Pack adds unique trailers, cargo and corporations alongside a brand new business venture led by horticultural specialist Ada Greenway. 

Patch delicate domes, keep habitats stocked with nutrients, and monitor your clients' crops as you unlock more than 30 themed customization rewards, including dashboard items, lighting options, palettes, and trims. 

 

The Cultivation Content Pack includes:  

  • x1 New Venture 

  • x4 New Cultivation Jobs 

  • x35 New Customization Rewards 

  • x3 New Corporations 

  • x4 New Trailer Types 

  • x10 New Cargo Visuals for Trailers 

  • x40 New Cargo Contracts for Freight Jobs
